Record the initial edit content_hash = hash_content(content) cursor.execute( 'INSERT INTO edits (entry_id, contributor, summary, edited_at, content_hash) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)', (entry_id, created_by, 'Initial creation', now, content_hash) ) conn.commit() conn.close() flash('Entry created successfully!', 'success') return redirect(url_for('view_entry', entry_id=entry_id)) return render_template_string(NEW_ENTRY_TEMPLATE) @app.route('/entries/', methods=['GET']) def view_entry(entry_id): """View a specific wiki entry.""" conn = get_db() cursor = conn.cursor() #
